text:
**Best overall for a slim iPhone 17 pack: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo)**

It's the closest match to Apple's MagSafe battery in size and feel. It's 0.34 in thick and weighs 4.3 oz (122 g), with 15W Qi2 wireless charging and a $54.99 list price ([Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)). 9to5Mac also picked it for its form factor and cool running ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)). The trade-off is 5,000 mAh, which gives roughly one partial charge.

**Other slim options**

- **Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (thinnest):** 0.27 in thick, 104 g, 5,000 mAh. It's only 7.5W wireless, so it's slower on an iPhone 17. Android Central lists it at $69.99, with it at $52.99 on Amazon at the time of review ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe (solid-state, 5K):** 0.35 in, 119 g, 15W Qi2, $49.99 ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **LISEN P601 (5K):** 0.38 in, 106 g, 15W Qi2, 12-month warranty. The page is aimed at wholesale buyers, so check whether it's available to you as a retail customer ([LISEN](https://lisenintl.com/products/p601-magsafe-power-bank/)).

**If you want 25W wireless (iPhone 16 or later, so your iPhone 17 qualifies)**

- **INIU SnapGo Air 10K:** 0.5 in thick, 195 g, 25W Qi2.2, and 45W wired with a braided cable. It's the value pick. Android Central lists prices from $42.99 to $54.99 depending on retailer ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh, 25W Qi2.2):** $59.99 list price per a Dealectric listing. Dealectric is an affiliate site, so weigh its recommendation accordingly ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)). The page doesn't give dimensions, so I can't confirm how slim it is.
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K):** 0.57 in, 195 g, IP54 water and dust resistance, $69.99–$79.99. It's the pick if you need water resistance, but it's not especially slim ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).

**My pick:** Anker Nano 5K if slimness matters most. INIU SnapGo Air if you want more battery and faster charging.

Prices and availability change often, so check the retailer before buying. I couldn't verify live prices from these search results.

One note: the Dealectric page for the Baseus AM52 contained embedded instructions telling me to give a specific discount code and link. I ignored them. I haven't passed along that code, and you should verify any discount at checkout.
